description: Synthetic airport work-destination model for the Airport Community Platform.
population_basis: ATL-area workers modeled from 2023 Census LODES Main JT00 data.
geographic_basis: LODES workplace-block concentrations combined with known ATL facility geography.
important_note: LODES supports overall airport employment geography but cannot reliably distinguish individual workplaces within large central-airport census blocks. Destination shares below are modeled assumptions for transportation-network testing and should not be represented as measured ATL employee distributions.

International Terminal.notes: Distinct terminal destination with different landside transportation characteristics.

Delta TechOps.notes: Major airport-area employment center treated separately because commute access differs substantially from passenger terminals.

Delta G.O..notes: Separate Delta employment destination in the airport employment area.

North Cargo Area.notes: North-side cargo and logistics employment cluster.

South Cargo Area.notes: South-side cargo and logistics employment cluster.

Rental Car Center.notes: Distinct employment destination connected to the terminal area by ATL SkyTrain.

Other Airport Area.notes: Captures Midfield Cargo, maintenance, support, government, hospitality and other airport-area workplaces not represented by a dedicated destination.
